title: Attribute Synthetic Monitoring costs to teams and services

blocks.content: Attribute Synthetics usage to the teams and services responsible for it by configuring attribution keys, then checking that your checks carry matching values.

blocks.title: Before you begin
blocks.content: This setup is for a Cost attribution admin who can edit an existing Synthetic Monitoring check. Use your organization’s approved attribution key and values. Keep existing keys and unrelated check labels; configuring a key does not backfill historical usage. Before repeating this guide or changing checks or attribution keys, click **Reset** beside each saved confirmation below, then **Reset guide**.
Review the Synthetics attribution settings before changing how usage is grouped.
Open **Cost Management and Billing → Settings** to review how Synthetics usage is attributed.
blocks.tooltip: Start with the keys your organization uses to divide its costs.

blocks.content: You have reached the settings where Synthetics attribution keys are configured.

blocks.prompt: Which approved Synthetics attribution key will you use? Keep an existing key if your organization already configured one.
blocks.validationMessage: Use a label name containing letters, numbers, and underscores, beginning with a letter or underscore.

blocks.content: Configure a missing attribution key, then review and save its values on an existing check.

blocks.title: Configure keys and label a check

blocks.content: Create the {{attributionKey}} attribution key: open the dialog, enter the key, and save it. If it already appears under **Synthetics attribution**, confirm that below instead. You can configure at most two keys; do not replace an existing key to make room.

steps.tooltip: Open the dialog to add the approved cost dimension.
Enter and select the approved key.
Save the new cost dimension without changing existing keys.

blocks.prompt: Confirm {{attributionKey}} appears under **Synthetics attribution**. A key under **Telemetry attribution** or **Performance attribution** does not configure Synthetics.
blocks.checkboxLabel: I confirmed this key is saved under Synthetics attribution.

blocks.content: Open **Checks** to apply your attribution keys to an existing check.
blocks.tooltip: Connect the cost dimension to the checks that generate the usage.

blocks.content: Choose an existing check you own and select its **Edit** control. Pick the check intentionally; keep its unrelated labels and settings.
blocks.tooltip: Use a check whose team or service ownership you know.

blocks.content: Open **Labels** to review the configured cost attribution keys and the values this check already carries.
blocks.tooltip: Compare the configured cost dimensions with this check’s existing values.

blocks.title: If the attribution fields are missing
blocks.content: If you still see **Set up cost attribution**, wait briefly and reopen the check. If the key remains absent, stop here: the saved CMAB configuration is not reaching Synthetic Monitoring. Creating another key or adding it as a custom label does not fix that configuration issue.
In **Cost attribution labels**, enter the correct value for {{attributionKey}}. Keep existing correct values and unrelated labels. An empty value remains unattributed.
blocks.tooltip: Fill only missing or incorrect values and preserve labels that already describe ownership.

blocks.content: Save the check if you changed any values. If its existing values are already correct and **Save** is disabled, skip this step.
blocks.tooltip: Confirm the saved check carries the intended cost dimensions and values.

blocks.prompt: Reopen the same check and its **Labels** tab. Confirm that {{attributionKey}} and its intended value were saved, with unrelated labels unchanged.
blocks.checkboxLabel: I reopened the check and confirmed the saved attribution value.

blocks.content: Attribution uses the configured key and the saved value on each check; historical usage is not backfilled.
